COMING SOON... 

ENQUIRE TODAY FOR PRIVATE ACCESS TO A PRE-MARKET VIEWING.

4 BEDROOM, 4 BATHROOM THREE-STOREY, END OF TERRACE PROPERTY

Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to announce that 267 The Boulevard is coming to Tyrrelstown property market soon. This property is currently being renovated in order for it to be ready for it’s new owner.

The layout of this property is as follows:

Ground Floor: Spacious hallway, living room, kitchen & downstairs bathroom.
Level One: A family bathroom, two double bedrooms and an en-suite.
Level Two: Two double bedrooms & a family bathroom.

The location is second to none within a 20 minute drive of Dublin International Airport.Clonee, Dunboyne, Clonsilla, Blanchardstown Village & Blanchardstown Shopping Centre are all within easy reach.Furthermore Tyrrelstown Village is within a few minutes with a wealth of amenities on your doorstep. D. 15's Corporate Parks and Connolly Hospital are also close by.

The Phoenix Park and Castleknock Village are within a 15 minute drive.The property also falls into an excellent catchment of both primary and secondary schools making it a real winner with families.The area is further serviced by an excellent bus route making the city centre most accessible. The M50 / M3 Motorways are also close to hand making this a most strategically positioned address.

Early viewing is highly recommended.

**Disclaimer:** While we have made every effort to ensure the accuracy of this information, some details may have been supplied by the vendor. We do not hold any responsibility for any errors or inaccuracies, and we encourage all viewers to seek their own professional advice.
